edits.new_content:
version: 2

sources:
  - name: raw
    schema: raw
    description: >
      Public signals landed by `gta6 ingest` as Parquet under data/raw/ and loaded by
      `gta6 load`. Every table is rebuilt from the files on each load; the newest pull
      wins per key. No post text, handles or usernames are stored.
    tables:
      - name: wiki_pageviews
        description: Daily English Wikipedia pageviews by users (all access) per article.
      - name: trends_interest
        description: >
          Google Trends relative interest (0-100) per term and day. Values only compare
          within one request_id; Google rescales every request to its own peak.
      - name: bluesky_daily_hits
        description: >
          Bluesky public search hitsTotal for one quoted seed phrase (optionally plus "gta")
          bounded to one UTC day. hits_total is NULL when the call failed.
      - name: hn_daily_hits
        description: >
          Hacker News (Algolia) nbHits for one quoted seed phrase (optionally plus "gta")
          over stories and comments in one UTC day. NULL when the call failed.

version: 2
models:
- name: fct_signal_daily
  description: One row per signal per UTC day inside the study and control windows, with its place relative to release.
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
          - signal_day_key
        population:
          rule: Signal-days whose date falls in dim_date; days outside the spine are dropped by the inner join.
        assumptions:
          - decision: Days outside the window
            chosen: dropped
            evidence: request
            detail: the study compares Thursdays in Oct-Nov 2026 against the same weeks of 2025; the inner join to dim_date keeps only that spine
            column: signal_date
          - decision: Surrogate key
            chosen: md5 of the natural grain
            evidence: default
            detail: the key is md5 of the composite Dex drafts as the grain, so the two describe the same rows; MetricFlow needs a single-column primary entity
          - decision: Thursday comparison roles
            chosen: removed
            evidence: request
            detail: they tagged the old index's release and baseline Thursdays
            column: comparison_role
          - decision: Google Trends rows and comparison roles
            chosen: removed
            evidence: request
            detail: 'user: scratch the old Day-Off Index; Trends moved to the new index'
            column: source
  columns:
  - name: source
    description: bluesky, hacker_news or wikipedia.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: signal
    description: What is counted, e.g. posts:day_off, posts:day_off_gta, pageviews:grand_theft_auto_vi.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: signal_family
    description: day_off_intent (people saying or searching they are off), day_off_gta (the same, mentioning GTA), hype (interest in GTA itself), reference.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: geo
    description: WORLD.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: signal_date
    description: UTC day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: time
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: signal_value
    description: Counts for posts and pageviews. Never add across signals or sources.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: 'NULL when the value could not be read: unavailable, never zero.'
          aggregation: sum
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: count or index (see signal)
  - name: is_available
    description: False when any part of the day's value failed to load or was partial.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: signal_day_key
    description: md5 of source|signal|geo|signal_date.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: key
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: study_year
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: days_from_release
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
          unit: days
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: iso_day_of_week
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null

version: 2

models:
  - name: int_signals__daily
    description: 'One row per signal per day: every source''s daily value in one shape.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          grain:
            - source
            - signal
            - geo
            - signal_date
          population:
            rule: Every staged day of every source; Bluesky and Hacker News seeds are summed per day and filter.
          assumptions:
            - decision: Combining seed phrases
              chosen: sum hits across seeds per day
              evidence: default
              detail: a post matching two seeds counts twice; the double count is the same on both Thursdays, so the lift is unaffected in expectation
            - decision: A partial or failed day
              chosen: signal_value NULL, is_available false
              evidence: request
              detail: 'docs/methodology.md: missing is unavailable, never zero'
            - decision: Google Trends signals
              chosen: removed; Trends now feeds only the Day-Off Index, weekly, through stg_trends__weekly
              evidence: request
              detail: 'user: scratch everything of the old Day-Off Index; the daily per-year Trends pulls were its input'
              column: source
    columns:
      - name: source
        description: bluesky, hacker_news or wikipedia.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              role: dimension
              null_rule: never
        data_tests:
          - not_null
      - name: signal

        config:

        config:

semantic_models:
- name: fct_signal_daily
  description: 'One row per signal per UTC day inside the study and control windows, with its place relative
    to release. Population: Signal-days whose date falls in dim_date; days outside the spine are dropped
    by the inner join.'
  model: ref('fct_signal_daily')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: signal_date
  entities:
  - name: signal_day
    type: primary
    expr: signal_day_key
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: source
    type: categorical
    description: bluesky, hacker_news or wikipedia.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: signal
    type: categorical
    description: What is counted, e.g. posts:day_off, posts:day_off_gta, pageviews:grand_theft_auto_vi.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: signal_family
    type: categorical
    description: day_off_intent (people saying or searching they are off), day_off_gta (the same, mentioning
      GTA), hype (interest in GTA itself), reference.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: geo
    type: categorical
    description: WORLD.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: signal_date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: UTC day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: study_year
    type: categorical
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: days_from_release
    type: categorical
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: days
          null_rule: never
  - name: iso_day_of_week
    type: categorical
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  measures:
  - name: signal_value_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: signal_value
    description: Daily value of a signal. Counts for posts and pageviews, 0-100 relative interest for
      Trends. Only meaningful grouped by source, signal and geo; never add across signals.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count or index (see signal)
          additivity: non_additive
          null_rule: NULL when the value could not be read
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        population:
          rule: Signal-days whose date falls in dim_date; days outside the spine are dropped by the inner
            join.
        assumptions:
        - decision: Days outside the window
          chosen: dropped
          evidence: request
          detail: the study compares Thursdays in Oct-Nov 2026 against the same weeks of 2025; the inner
            join to dim_date keeps only that spine
          column: signal_date
        - decision: Surrogate key
          chosen: md5 of the natural grain
          evidence: default
          detail: the key is md5 of the composite Dex drafts as the grain, so the two describe the same
            rows; MetricFlow needs a single-column primary entity
